title: Shinonome Ena — This Claw's Too Weak!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, K.
Tomorrow, we're going for a walk like we planned.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll be looking forward to it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Since you two are gonna be exercising tomorrow, why don't you log off early today?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. Once a I reach a good place to stop, I'll probably got to bed for a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, me too.
So, I'll be getting back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okie dokie♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Finished...!
Hehe. I got a lot more done than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now to send it off to Kanade and the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I can log off now, but I don't feel that sleepy yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. I'll spend this time looking up how to get the most out of our walk...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since we're actually going through with this, we should figure out how to efficiently benefit from it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's start with...
“Getting the most out of a walk”... Search...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I got a ton of results.
Which ones look good...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this site's really well written, and it includes some nice figures...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's see... Oh, here we go.
A whole section about getting more out of your walk!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Stretch before and after you go on your walk.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Stretch prior to exercising in order to warm up your joints and afterwards to loosen your muscles and help them recover.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, so it's important to keep stuff like this in mind even when you're just going for a walk...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And there's a video about proper walking form down below. I think I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Play... Oh, I should unplug my headphones and lower the volume...

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <Alright, let's talk about some important tips and tricks to getting the most out of your walk!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's nice that they're getting right to it. Videos with long-winded introductions really bug me sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <First, your shoulder blades and pelvis! You may often see people aggressively swinging their arms out in front while walking.>

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <However, it's more important to focus on your shoulder blades and pelvis! By properly alternating between each side, you'll get the core workout you're looking for.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, my shoulder blades and pelvis...

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line:
<So, let's give it a try!
First, move your right hand and left foot forward!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My right hand and left foot...

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <Now, check to see where your shoulder blades and pelvis are facing. Next, instead of your arms and legs, think about moving your shoulder blades and pelvis.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uhh... Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <When you move, try to keep your limbs from flailing. Your goal is simply to gently push them forward!>

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line:
<How is it?
Can you feel the muscles in your core as you use them?>

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <Alright, let's take one more step!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Oh, I am starting to feel it around my midriff.

rows.Speaker: Video Trainer
rows.Line: <By using your core as you walk, you're also helping your internal organs do their job and making your body just that much healthier.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I see.
This video's really good and easy to understand. I think I'll share it with Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree. It's a bit hard to tell how they're moving their arms and legs without any visual aids...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And I'm curious to hear what their other important point is...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When did I get unmuted?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Remember how you unplugged your headphones when you decided to follow along? I think that was when it happened.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think that happens to all of us. We forget that unplugging our headphones can cause our computers to turn our mics back on.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, if you could hear, why didn't you tell me sooner...?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, hold up. One second, we were just trying to work, and the next, we have someone yelling, “Alright, here's how to get the most out of your walk!” in our ears.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We figured that you were watching a video, Enanan, and I was doing everything I could to not laugh out loud♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm not letting you forget this, Amia! You better watch out the next time we see each other!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
Sorry about that, K. I didn't mean to interrupt you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's okay. Actually, I'd like to thank you for finding that video. If you don't mind sharing it with me, I'd like to watch it later.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, of course.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Let's learn everything we can from this video and make sure we get in a good walk, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, let's.>
